filings.ai_summary: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. completed its acquisition of Anysphere, Inc. on August 14, 2026.
Space Exploration Technologies Corp. reported significant cash and marketable securities, with ongoing investments in space, connectivity, and AI segments.
Space Exploration Technologies Corp. announced its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
Space Exploration Technologies Corp. issued $23 billion in senior unsecured notes with varying interest rates and maturity dates.
Space Exploration Technologies Corp. priced a $23 billion senior unsecured notes offering to repay debt and for general corporate purposes.
SpaceX has $100.8 billion in cash and cash equivalents as of June 19, 2026.
Space Exploration Technologies Corp. appointed Roelof Botha to its Board of Directors and Audit Committee.

filings.summary: Material agreement signed; Unregistered share sale
filings.ai_summary: Space Exploration Technologies announced its subsidiary X67 will merge with Anysphere, making Anysphere a wholly owned subsidiary and converting Cursor shares into SpaceX stock at a $60 billion implied value, with the deal expected to close in Q3 2026.

Space Exploration Technologies Corp. is offering 555,555,555 shares of Class A common stock at $135.00 per share.
